Here's the result of running `cat -n` on /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/pcre2/src/pcre2_match.c:
  5220	
  5221	    /* ===================================================================== */
  5222	    /* The callout item calls an external function, if one is provided, passing
  5223	    details of the match so far. This is mainly for debugging, though the
  5224	    function is able to force a failure. */
  5225	
  5226	    case OP_CALLOUT:
  5227	    case OP_CALLOUT_STR:
  5228	    rrc = do_callout(F, mb, &length);
  5229	    if (rrc > 0) RRETURN(MATCH_NOMATCH);
  5230	    if (rrc < 0) RRETURN(rrc);
  5231	    Fecode += length;
  5232	    break;
  5233	
  5234	
  5235	    /* ===================================================================== */
  5236	    /* Conditional group: compilation checked that there are no more than two
  5237	    branches. If the condition is false, skipping the first branch takes us
  5238	    past the end of the item if there is only one branch, but that's exactly
  5239	    what we want. */
  5240	
  5241	    case OP_COND:
  5242	    case OP_SCOND:
  5243	
  5244	    /* The variable Flength will be added to Fecode when the condition is
  5245	    false, to get to the second branch. Setting it to the offset to the ALT or
  5246	    KET, then incrementing Fecode achieves this effect. However, if the second
  5247	    branch is non-existent, we must point to the KET so that the end of the
  5248	    group is correctly processed. We now have Fecode pointing to the condition
  5249	    or callout. */
  5250	
  5251	    Flength = GET(Fecode, 1);    /* Offset to the second branch */
  5252	    if (Fecode[Flength] != OP_ALT) Flength -= 1 + LINK_SIZE;
  5253	    Fecode += 1 + LINK_SIZE;     /* From this opcode */
  5254	
  5255	    /* Because of the way auto-callout works during compile, a callout item is
  5256	    inserted between OP_COND and an assertion condition. Such a callout can
  5257	    also be inserted manually. */
  5258	
  5259	    if (*Fecode == OP_CALLOUT || *Fecode == OP_CALLOUT_STR)
  5260	      {
  5261	      rrc = do_callout(F, mb, &length);
  5262	      if (rrc > 0) RRETURN(MATCH_NOMATCH);
  5263	      if (rrc < 0) RRETURN(rrc);
  5264	
  5265	      /* Advance Fecode past the callout, so it now points to the condition. We
  5266	      must adjust Flength so that the value of Fecode+Flength is unchanged. */
  5267	
  5268	      Fecode += length;
  5269	      Flength -= length;
  5270	      }
